thread:
Anna L: Kickoff for greenfield onprem VPC delivery for ACME corp. We start network handoff tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final checklist: airgap seed images, KMS egress rules, GPU pool sizing, BGP peering validation, and acceptance tests. TL;DR: who owns each validation?
Raj P: I can own network side. Will confirm BGP session params, ASN, and routes. Need customer's edge ASN and allowed prefixes from their firewall team. I have a template I can send.
Carmen S: I'll own image seeding + registry sync and the GPU commissioning steps. Airgap registry mirror will use our signed images, OCIR tar. Will post exact commands in a minute.
Sam O: Assigning owners in ticket INFRA-743. @Anna L please add expected capacity: GPUs and expected qps for initial canary.
Anna L: Initial commit: 8x A100 per cluster, target 200 concurrent generation streams, reserve 10% headroom. Cost note: temporary dedicated capacity vs private—we'll budget for 3 months of reserved support.
Taylor M: SRE checklist draft: health endpoints, node-exporter metrics, NVML exporter, nvidia-smi smoke, container runtime oom logs, and autoscaler policies. Also plan for instance replacement flow.
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onprem/greenfield-delivery (doc created) :white_check_mark:
Raj P: Customer provided ASN 65042, allowed prefixes: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24. Peering policy: no default route; only specific /24s. Need to verify MTU 9000 and TCP MSS clamping on their firewall.
Carmen S: Airgap seed commands (local mirror):
```
# on airgap seed box
skopeo copy docker://redwood/rt-runtime:1.4 docker-archive:/tmp/rt-1.4.tar
scp /tmp/rt-1.4.tar seed-box:/var/seed
```
Also need to sign images with cosign and provide pubkey to customer.
Sam O: Acceptance criteria for handoff: 1) BGP session established, 2) All required routes present, 3) Seed images verified by customer, 4) GPU nodes pass nvidia-smi burn-in 10min, 5) Canary inference latency < 120ms p50. Anything else?
Taylor M: Add: KV cache persistence verified, model weights checksum verified, and rollbacks tested (switch to hosted variant) as fallback.
Anna L: Quick final checklist for tomorrow: - Raj: BGP + firewall rules - Carmen: seed + cosign pubkey - Sam: coordinate windows with customer (2h window) - Taylor: deploy canary job + smoke tests I'll be oncall for the window. :spiral_calendar:
Raj P: Note on NAT/egress: KMS calls need to hit 3 external IPs (kms-us.redwood.net). Customer asked to restrict egress; propose using a static NAT on our side through a proxy in DMZ. Need their approval.
Carmen S: For GPU commissioning: run:
```
./commission_gpu.sh --nodes 8 --tests smi,mem,perf --duration 600
```
Outputs are uploaded to s3-compatible bucket on seed box. Share manifest with customer.
Sam O: Timebox: start at 09:00 PT, duration 3 hours, rollback window 30m. I'll update INFRA-743 with times and dial-in.
Taylor M: Cost FYI: Onprem support spike expected ~$12k one-time (image/prep) + ~$2k/month ops for 3 months. Flagging with finance.
Anna L: Good. If no blockers I'll mark this ready-to-run. Last call?
Raj P: No blockers from network side. :thumbsup: \nCarmen S: Ready. I'll push scripts to seed box tonight.
ops-bot: Incident-flag: none. Scheduled window INFRA-743 created (2032470000). :white_check_mark:
